quick_walkthrough.title: 1 · Beyond Plain Text · Clear Visual Cards
quick_walkthrough.speech: When you ask an AI assistant for help, you usually get a long wall of text. Lumina changes that—giving AI a trusted menu of forty-nine visual building blocks, so everyday answers look like clean, interactive cards.
quick_walkthrough.tts: When you ask an A-I assistant for help, you usually get a long wall of text. Lumina changes that, giving A-I a trusted menu of forty-nine visual building blocks, so everyday answers look like clean, interactive cards.

quick_walkthrough.title: 2 · Tap & Drag Live · No Extra Typing
quick_walkthrough.props: Live Sliders · Proportion Split Bar · Instant Math
quick_walkthrough.speech: Instead of typing follow-up messages just to test different numbers, people can switch to a live savings calculator and drag monthly deposits or return rates—watching their projected thirty-year balance update on the spot.
quick_walkthrough.tts: Instead of typing follow-up messages just to test different numbers, people can switch to a live savings calculator and drag monthly deposits or return rates, watching their projected thirty-year balance update on the spot.

quick_walkthrough.title: 3 · Cited Sources, Charts & Side Reports
quick_walkthrough.props: Clickable Sources · Interactive Charts · Clean Side Panel
quick_walkthrough.speech: Research answers stay easy to verify. Assistants can attach clickable web sources, plot interactive charts, and tuck long memos neatly into a side panel instead of crowding the conversation.
quick_walkthrough.tts: Research answers stay easy to verify. Assistants can attach clickable web sources, plot interactive charts, and tuck long memos neatly into a side panel instead of crowding the conversation.

quick_walkthrough.title: 4 · Built-In Human Sign-Off
quick_walkthrough.props: Reservation Summary · Required Check · Locked Approval Gate
quick_walkthrough.speech: Before an AI books a hotel, moves money, or applies a change, built-in approval gates keep the confirm button safely locked until a person reviews the summary and checks the box.
quick_walkthrough.tts: Before an A-I books a hotel, moves money, or applies a change, built-in approval gates keep the confirm button safely locked until a person reviews the summary and checks the box.

quick_walkthrough.title: 5 · One Reply Fits Computer, Tablet & Phone
quick_walkthrough.props: Laptop + Phone Sync · Light & Dark Mode · Safe Data Only
quick_walkthrough.speech: Best of all, the AI sends one simple data message—never raw code—and Lumina adapts every layout automatically across laptop, tablet, and phone, in both Light and Dark mode.
